supporting_observations.claim: The alerted failures are recorded on FILE-MAP-01, with WorkstationName=FILE-MAP-01 and the same source address, 10.53.20.20, across the sequence; the failed authentication reports an incorrect-password status (0xc000006a).

The failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals, consistent with the supplied inventory description that the DocSync job on FILE-MAP-01 runs every minute and re-authenticates each run. The supplied change calendar schedules svc-docsync password rotation at 13:30 UTC, shortly before the failures begin at 13:37 UTC; this supports stale job credentials after rotation as a benign explanation.
The supplied records show failed authentication attempts for the alerted account, but do not show a successful authentication in this sequence.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied authentication records show LSASS as the process for the failures; they do not identify the DocSync job executable or prove which component supplied the credentials.
The evidence provided is a set of authentication records, not a complete account of all activity on FILE-MAP-01 or DC-MAP-01 during the review window.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish whether the scheduled password rotation completed successfully or whether the DocSync job was subsequently updated with the new password.
The supplied records do not establish whether any successful svc-docsync authentication occurred outside the records shown.
unrelated_findings: Separate review recommended: at 13:59 UTC, a DC-MAP-01 explicit-credentials event records SYSTEM using svc-docsync credentials toward PROXY-MAP-01, with Veeam.Backup.Service.exe as the process. This differs from the recurring failed DocSync authentication sequence; the record alone does not establish whether the use was authorized or malicious. (T162-00035)
